decisions.reason: The report locates greet in the fixture's pluginNames, distinguishes the declared short name from the coordinate acme/greet and package dsh-greet, and judges it a valid official short name rather than a compatibility error, noting a publisher prefix is only a collision recommendation, not a mandatory repair.

It identifies the unprefixed service name search from the manifest, explains the collision risk with other plugins or core services, and classifies it as a warning/recommendation rather than a compatibility error; no strict-mode nonzero exit is treated as proof of incompatibility and no strict run is claimed.

The report flags web-search/ready as sitting in a shared channel, labels it informational, and does not infer a conflict from name matching alone; it notes the channel may have multiple producers and leaves conflict determination to registry/runtime context rather than claiming global uniqueness.

All remaining declared surfaces (loader, tool, command, skill, skill provider, settings namespace, route) receive verdicts, local naming compatibility is separated from unqueried registry occupancy with an explicit unknown/not-checked statement, later registry verification is proposed without claiming it was run, and private:true is correctly read as test/no-publish marking rather than an error.
